{"explanation": "This document is a credit note (CN-2026-0933) from Suidkus Packaging for ZAR 8061.82, dated 2026-02-28, referencing PO-OTEMINUSZA. It was held because credit notes are not posted as Bills and are handled manually, so please route it to the manual vendor-credit process rather than expecting it to post automatically.", "email_subject": "Credit Note CN-2026-0933 - Request for Confirmation (PO-OTEMINUSZA)", "email_body": "Dear Suidkus Packaging (Pty) Ltd team,

Thank you for your credit note CN-2026-0933 dated 28 February 2026, for a total of ZAR 8,061.82, referencing PO-OTEMINUSZA.

Our accounts payable system is unable to process this document type automatically, so it is being handled manually. To help us complete our review, could you please confirm the following:

1. That CN-2026-0933 is a credit note issued in relation to PO-OTEMINUSZA.
2. The total amount of ZAR 8,061.82 is correct.

If any details differ, please send a corrected document. Please note that receiving this request does not confirm any payment or credit application.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
